purpose: Join selected-action anchors to explicit class-matched atom support, selected-event visible consequence support, and sequence-metric evidence-anchor support without creating terminal, sequence, possession, causal, progression, or tactical truth.

sequence_consequence.support_limit: Sequence metric evidence-anchor IDs are support-only and may be intentionally partial. They are not a complete per-anchor trace inventory.

exact_join: all three input payloads explicitly carry the same non-empty match_surface_binding_id
explicit per-record match_surface_binding_id equality without payload fallback
explicit per-record actor_identity_candidate_id presence and equality
explicit JSON null actor identity is allowed only for non-actor-bound source roles; blank or whitespace actor IDs are invalid
selected-event consequence_class_candidate is explicitly present and non-empty
sequence metric evidence_anchor_node_id references an existing selected_action_node_id
atom_support_integrity: support_atom_class_counts total equals unique supporting_evidence_atom_ids count
terminal_outcome_support_visible=true requires TERMINAL_OUTCOME_ATOM count greater than zero
derived_consequence_support_visible=true requires DERIVED_CONSEQUENCE_ATOM count greater than zero
atom class present while corresponding flag is false is a conflict
mismatched flag, class count, duplicate ID, invalid count, or missing inventory blocks downstream promotion

admission_rules.when: terminal_outcome_support_visible=true, TERMINAL_OUTCOME_ATOM count is positive, atom IDs reconcile with class counts, all payload bindings are explicit and equal, selected-event consequence class exists, and exact record lineage exists

derived_consequence_support_visible=true, DERIVED_CONSEQUENCE_ATOM count is positive, atom IDs reconcile with class counts, all payload bindings are explicit and equal, selected-event consequence class exists, and exact record lineage exists
selected-event consequence class is explicitly present, non-empty and resolved, and every required record-level lineage field is explicitly present and compatible
only sequence metric evidence-anchor support is available after all three payload bindings are explicitly present and equal
two or more compatible support sources are visible after payload-binding, exact-lineage, consequence-class and atom-class integrity gates

required payload binding or record lineage is missing or conflicting, actor identity is blank instead of explicit null, selected-event consequence class is missing or empty, payload fallback would be required, or explicit support flags and atom classes do not reconcile
no compatible support source is visible
